name: botflow-ads
description: BotFlow Ads — Telegram-native Sponsored Post Ads Network

scripts.build: npm ci --include=dev && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @botflow/shared && npm run build -w @botflow/backend && npm run build -w @botflow/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @botflow/backend && npm run typecheck -w @botflow/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @botflow/frontend && npm run test -w @botflow/backend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w @botflow/backend && npm run test -w @botflow/frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
